notes: iPads, phones and computers are added once, then open Diastema at your office's secure address from anywhere, not just on the office's internet connection. Add one from Settings → Devices (scan the QR code with the device, or type the short code on it), or, on the office's internet connection, tap "Ask to add it" on the device and approve it from the banner after checking the number on its screen. Managers and admins can add and remove devices (Settings → Users & access). After this update, each iPad and phone that already uses the secure address needs to be added once. Everyone still signs in with their PIN; 10 wrong PINs in a row on one device remove it. Computers using the office-network address aren't affected.
